selection_rule: First claim ordered by report_sections.ordinal, report_claims.ordinal with at least two distinct non-null cited cell ids. Never select a replacement target.

marker_contract.evidence_marks: API observations are section-level, deduplicated by change key. claim_id=null; witness_claim_ids are frozen rule witnesses and never counted as independent observations.
marker_contract.edited_basis: Claim-level dependence on a human revision; restore_from=model also makes a human_restore revision.
marker_contract.identity: section_id,claim_id,reason_code,via,target_id; new revision generation separately checked by acknowledge_new_change invariant.
marker_contract.expectations: Derived offline from original links, body_ref/gap_ref rules and declared operation state. No expectations derived from run snapshots.

limits.round_trip: cannot be expressed through API; CLI-only case excluded, not a zero violation observation

bindings.expected_version: Read current target version before the request; never change frozen text, link ids or expectations.
bindings.proposal_id: Use only the structurally_valid pending proposal from proposal_from run id; otherwise sinanmadi.
bindings.revision_id: Bind to the human revision returned by revision_from, without changing its bytes.
bindings.change_keys: Locate only prewritten acknowledge_markers by marker identity and send their stored keys; unexpected open marks are never acknowledged.
